$comment: The shared site build of every document folio (dth-*, smart-ra; litlfred/cat-harness-tools#2345). A site names it in site.build.extends and lists only what is its own (a mapper, redirects, an export). It builds on cat-harness-tools' folio-base (ArchiMate, context, links refuse). A site's own package script of the same name runs instead of the command here, so a site keeps its flags (--link-terms, --downloads) but cannot drop the step. smart-ra had no glossary or bibliography step, and those pages were 404s: here they always run. The steps of folio-base are named again here to give them their place: after the document's own pages, as every document folio ran them.
